teams.title: Teams
teams.name: Team name
teams.joinHelp: Ask a team admin for the invitation ID shown in Members. Sign in with the invited, verified email address.
teams.empty: Your personal workspace is getting ready.
teams.confirmLeave: Leave this team? You’ll need a new invitation to return.
teams.confirmRemove: Remove this member? They’ll need a new invitation to return.
teams.confirmDemote: Give up your admin role? Another admin will manage this team.
teams.created: Team created. Select it in Your workspaces to switch.
teams.error.last-admin: You’re the last admin. Make another member an admin before leaving or giving up your admin role.
teams.error.busy: Another team change is in progress. Wait a moment, then try again.
teams.error.reconciliation: A team change needs support to check its outcome. Contact Onlook before trying again.
teams.error.sign-in-required: Sign in again to manage your teams.
teams.error.switch-required: Couldn’t switch workspaces. Your team may require a new sign-in. Try signing in again.
teams.error.invalid-request: Check the details and try again.
teams.error.offline: Reconnect to Onlook to manage your teams.
teams.error.unavailable: Teams aren’t available in this build.
teams.error.failed: Couldn’t complete the team change. Check your access and the details, then try again.
